_comment: M1.6 horizontal ROOM slice. Logical units and state speeds are gameplay mappings, not universal biological constants.

directional._tilt_geometry_comment: M1.8-N4B5R runtime candidate (ROOM only). The tilt foreshortening term is weighted by cos(elevation) = horizontal / 3-D fly-paddle distance, so the horizontal bearing no longer turns into apparent looming when the paddle is nearly overhead. bearing_only_v0 (the default when absent) is the accepted M1.5/M1.7 formula. Geometry only: the N4B1C decoder is unchanged.

physical._comment: M1.7 edge repair: head extent may leave the viewport; center_inset bounds the physical center only. Dynamics are gameplay mappings.

approach_tracking._comment: World-side velocity matching plus bounded positional correction. No fly coordinates or threat-state inputs. Filter command continuously at paddle substeps.

fly._comment: body_length_px defines body length in logical world units. Rendering scales it to display pixels; physics uses logical units/s.

encoder._comment: LC4/LPLC2 populations are subsampled to min(left, right) using encoder_seed, matching PROTOCOL.md's balancing rule.

policy._comment: Exact provenance required. The M1.8-N4B1C lateral dual-path decoder (unchanged) loads the M1.8-N4B5R geometry-candidate record, which carries the identical decoder block for the elevation-aware geometry configuration: rebuild it with python tools/n4b5r_geometry_record.py. The N4B1C decoder record itself is preserved unchanged. tools/calibrate_escape.py measures the scalar single-sample criterion only and does not calibrate this decoder.

escape_decoder._comment: M1.8-N4B1C combined DNp01 criterion. Escape when EITHER path qualifies outside the shared refractory period. LATERAL: the same DNp01 side produces lateral_required_spikes inferred spikes within lateral_same_side_window_ms (per-side spikes inferred from that side's own trace; a left spike followed by a right spike never qualifies). Summed N2b path: FAST when left + right >= summed_fast_threshold; SUSTAINED when the current summed sample is >= sustained_threshold AND at least sustained_required_samples of the most recent sustained_window_samples summed samples are >= sustained_threshold. All values are Class C engineering decoder parameters derived from simulator evidence, not biological constants. sustained_threshold must equal the record's escape_threshold.

saccades._comment: Turn actuator bounds. Duration is derived from a peak angular speed, so bigger turns take longer and no pulse exceeds peak_rate_cap.

flight._comment: Category B: phenomenological free flight and boundary behaviour. Seeded, local, and independent of the connectome.

ecology._comment: Phenomenological state/flight mappings. No olfactory connectome circuit or learning is implemented.

kinematics._comment: M1.8-B2a. room_kinematic_scale is a Class C simulator/environment mapping from body-length-normalized ecological speed to ROOM world units. It is NOT a measured biological constant and no literature magnitude has been adopted. 1.0 is the accepted no-op value. It applies only to non-neural ecological locomotion; threat-priority, landing approach and takeoff are excluded. M1.8-B2b-i separates the overloaded fly.max_speed into three Class C engineering ceilings: ecological locomotion, the accepted legacy neural/escape and lifecycle constraint, and a global numerical safety guard. All three are held at the legacy 1000.0 units/s so behavior is unchanged. None is a species flight maximum.

explore_speed_bl_s._comment: M1.8-B2b-ii. One sampled EXPLORE target per ecological EXPLORE episode, replacing the shared deterministic 8 s speed sinusoid for this context only. The shape is PHENOMENOLOGICAL: no reviewed source measures a free-flight speed distribution shape, and E02/E03 do not supply a usable central tendency, spread or support for ROOM. Support and mean are held at the accepted EXPLORE envelope so this stage changes the sampling model, not the magnitude. Persistence is the existing ecology.explore_duration_seconds dwell; no new persistence parameter is added.
